lines: # Start the monitor in its own process group so we can kill the whole tree
-    # Give the monitor time to start dbus-monitor and connect to the bus
+    # Wait until the monitor's own bus connection appears (a new unique
+    # name) before yielding: signals sent before dbus-monitor subscribes
+    # are lost, and its startup time under CPU contention is unbounded
+    # relative to any fixed sleep. If the monitor process has already
+        "lock-monitor never connected to the session bus"
